title: Elf Bar 600 Elfturbo Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Elfturbo Prefilled Pods are designed for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, bringing a lively and refreshing fruit flavour inspired by sports drinks. Each pack contains two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, with each pod delivering up to 600 puffs depending on usage. Their inhale-activated design makes them simple to use, producing a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw without the need for buttons, refills, or coil changes. The flavour blends mixed summer fruits with the bright, lightly tangy pop of a sports drink, rounded off with a subtle cooling note. It’s a combination that tastes fresh and uplifting, making it an easy option for everyday vaping. Replacing pods is straightforward and mess-free — once empty, just click in a fresh one and continue.
